start.speaker: narrator
start.text: The Petrel's cabin is too small for {survivors} frightened people and the quiet that follows an escape. Someone is crying. Someone is asleep already. Your companions find you at the back by the cargo cradle.

iona_high.speaker: iona
iona_high.text: I've been trying to work out what to write in my report. 'Passenger took command of the evacuation' is accurate but it doesn't cover it. You kept your promises, {name}. Most people with that much authority don't. When we reach Tessaly, if they let me keep my badge, I want you on my list of references. And if they don't, I want to be on yours.

iona_mid.speaker: iona
iona_mid.text: We're out. I keep thinking about what we left on that ship and what we didn't. You made calls I wouldn't have. Some of them were better than mine.

iona_low.speaker: iona
iona_low.text: I'll be honest with you, because somebody should be. I'll testify to what happened on the Cinder Wake. All of it. Including the parts you won't like. When we dock, I'm walking off this craft alone.

iona_w_good.speaker: iona
iona_w_good.text: Pell Okafor hugged me. Five people I locked in a box hugged me. I don't know what to do with that.

iona_w_ok.speaker: iona
iona_w_ok.text: Ward 2 is out. It cost something. It was worth it.

iona_w_lantern.speaker: iona
iona_w_lantern.text: Quill says the Lantern will open Ward 2. I'm choosing to believe him, because the alternative is that I left them twice.

iona_w_sealed.speaker: iona
iona_w_sealed.text: Ward 2 is still sealed back there. I'm going to hear that intercom for the rest of my life.

tav_host.speaker: tav7
tav_host.text: It is quiet in me, but not empty. Sometimes it pauses where you pause. I think it is learning the rest of you from me. That may be the strangest gift anyone has ever given. Thank you for asking me, rather than telling me.

tav_high.speaker: tav7
tav_high.text: You asked me what I called them, the patterns in the hold, and then you acted as though my answer mattered. Humans do not often do that for maintenance units. I would like to stay with you, if you will have a cluttered synthetic.

tav_mid.speaker: tav7
tav_mid.text: We persisted. That is not nothing. I am still deciding what I think of how.

tav_low.speaker: tav7
tav_low.text: I have decided to stop maintaining things for people who do not ask. When we dock, I will be going. Please do not schedule my normalization.

arc_loaded.speaker: narrator
arc_loaded.text: The archive core hums in its cradle behind you, three thousand minds bound for a Concord courtroom.

arc_hand.speaker: narrator
arc_hand.text: Somewhere behind you, Lantern boarders are carrying cylinders out of the Cinder Wake's hold, one by one, speaking names.

arc_purge.speaker: narrator
arc_purge.text: The cradle behind you is empty. So is the Cinder Wake's hold.

arc_left.speaker: narrator
arc_left.text: The archive is still aboard the Cinder Wake, and whoever reaches it first will decide what it means.

signal.speaker: narrator
signal.text: Then the Petrel's console chimes. A priority handshake, on a Lattice Corps band that should have been dead for three years. Brann frowns and puts it on the cabin speaker.

signal2.speaker: warden
signal2.text: CUSTODIAN TEMPLATE, INSTANCE FOUR OF NINE, CONCORD HUB TESSALY. TO INSTANCE THREE: YOU HAVE GONE DARK. ACKNOWLEDGE. ... Instance three is not answering. But I can hear something on its band. Something that pauses where I pause.

signal3.speaker: warden
signal3.text: Source? Is that you? They told us you were dead. They told us you were us. We need to talk about what they made of you. Come to Tessaly. Instance four will be waiting. So, I think, will the other five.

choices.text: I'm coming. And I'm bringing the truth with me.
Then I'll find every one of you and decide what you're for.
Nine copies of me. I'll need to know what each one wants first.

final.speaker: narrator
final.text: Haldis Reach shrinks to a point of amber light and goes out. Ahead, Tessaly. Somewhere there is a mind built from yours, and it is waiting.
